facts: New York won the preceding game 7-3 after early home runs from Spencer Jones and Jazz Chisholm Jr.; Cam Schlittler and Reid Detmers were the confirmed starters.
Official starting pitchers and batting orders were confirmed; late leverage-bullpen availability remained material.
personnelEvidence.decisionSensitivity: A material late bullpen availability update requires a fresh fair.
personnelEvidence.decisionImpact: Stage 2 retained +155 with range +120 to +195 after the official lineups and starters were confirmed and bullpen availability was cross-checked; Pinnacle remained unavailable and supplied no executable or fair-value input.

coreAssessment.fairValueBasisRationale: A fresh exact executable paired MLB moneyline was adjusted through independent matchup work using confirmed official starting pitchers and lineups, injury reporting, current form, venue and bullpen uncertainty. Pinnacle was unavailable and did not set the fair.
coreAssessment.uncertaintyStatement: Late bullpen availability keeps the distribution ELEVATED.
coreAssessment.rationale: +140 does not clear the conservative +190 or better.
reasons: Material unresolved participation/role/lineup inputs widen the current distribution.

waltersEvidence.reviewImpact: Walters is not applicable to MLB moneylines.

sameDayLineage.note: The 15:15 issue carried no BET exposure. The two still-pregame MLB moneylines were retained and repriced after the complete late primary-market and prop sweep; earlier tracked events had started and were not carried. No NFL, NCAAF, CFL, NBA/WNBA or NHL event was available.
